demo.title: demo.sh
demo.code:
cd flash/scripts && npm install

# What is live: FLASH price, King of the Hill, perps, QUANT
node flash.mjs overview

# Buy FLASH with 0.01 ETH (simulated, unsigned plan; submit via Bankr /wallet/submit)
node flash.mjs swap --market FLASH --side buy --amount 0.01 --wallet 0xYOUR_BANKR_WALLET

# Go 2x long ETH with 25 USDC
node flash.mjs swap --market ETH2xL --side buy --amount 25 --wallet 0xYOUR_BANKR_WALLET

# Sell 50 FLASH as a limit-order curve from 2x to 20x the current price
node flash.mjs limit-place --market FLASH --amount 50 --low-mult 2 --high-mult 20 --bins 16 --wallet 0xYOUR_BANKR_WALLET

setup: Chain: Base (8453). Install node >= 18, then run npm install in flash/scripts (one dependency: viem).
Log in to Bankr with a read-write key that has walletApiEnabled; keep 'Enable arbitrary contract calls' on (bankr.bot -> Security). Keep a little ETH on Base for gas.

Flow: run a flash.mjs command with --wallet -> check ok/status -> validate per references/TX-VALIDATION.md -> submit transactions[] in order via /wallet/submit (chainId 8453, keep the gas field, waitForConfirmation).
The CLI simulates approvals + action from your wallet (eth_simulateV1) before returning a plan; it never signs or broadcasts.
Contracts: known-contracts.json · Read API: https://api.tryflash.app/v1/stack · App: https://tryflash.app
